expects.rule: A legal-age check on entry that is one question with Yes and No (or a birth year), states the age rule applied, and remembers the answer.
Visits and tastings have their own menu entry with formats, duration, price per person and a booking button, not only an email address.
Address, opening days and hours of the cellar door or shop, and how to get there are plain text, with seasonal closures stated.
Each wine or spirit has a page with grape or botanicals, vintage or age, tasting notes, technical sheet and a price or a where-to-buy link.
The estate is shown with real photographs of its vineyards, cellar or still and the people who work there, not generic bottle-and-glass imagery.
The legally required health warning for the market is present (in France: 'L'abus d'alcool est dangereux pour la santé, à consommer avec modération').
A language switch for the main export and visitor markets.

traits: 6 of 8 show an age check on entry (Monemvasia asks a birth year digit by digit; Lafon-Rochet, Citadelle and Sir Chill ask Yes or No; De Lossy asks a birth year; Ses Talaioles a Confirm button); none was seen on LEA or Rutherford Ranch.
7 of 8 have a language switch (Sir Chill offers six languages, Ses Talaioles three, Citadelle three); Rutherford Ranch is English only.

5 of 8 have a visit or tour entry in the menu (Monemvasia, Ses Talaioles, Lafon-Rochet, Citadelle, Rutherford Ranch), but only Monemvasia shows tasting formats with prices (€15 for 4 wines, €25 for 6) and Book Now buttons on the home page.

4 of 8 sell from the site (Monemvasia and Ses Talaioles with prices and a cart, Rutherford Ranch with a promo banner, De Lossy through an external Shopify Buy Now); Sir Chill sends to a distributor finder; LEA, Lafon-Rochet and Citadelle do not sell.
None of the 8 states cellar-door opening hours on the home page; 2 give a street address (LEA, Lafon-Rochet).
Headlines are a place or a date, not a product: 'La pépite de Saint-Estèphe', 'Living beautifully since 1862', 'Aromas of the Mediterranean', founded 1997.

sites.name: Monemvasia Winery
sites.why: Family winery in Laconia, Greece. Birth-year age gate, headline that the winery was founded in 1997, menu Winery / Wines / Visit with Tour-Tasting, Reviews and eshop, four tasting formats with Book Now buttons (Tour Tasting 4 wines €15, Terroir 6 wines €25, private, educational), wines with prices and add-to-cart (€12 to €14.80), EN switch. No address or hours on the home page.

sites.name: LEA Winery
sites.why: Winery in Friuli, Italy. Spaced capitals tagline 'Innovative to be natural', intro video 'Guardiamo alla terra con infinito rispetto', menu Chi siamo / Tenuta / I vini / Sostenibilità / Mondo No Alcol / Contatti, three wine brands as cut-out bottle shots, downloadable company profile and sustainability report, it/en switch, address and phone in the footer. No shop, visit booking or prices.

sites.name: Ses Talaioles
sites.why: Finca and winery in eastern Mallorca. Age modal 'Welcome to Finca Ses Talaioles' with Confirm, headline 'Aromas of the Mediterranean' over a photograph of the historic tower, menu Finca / Wine / Terroir / Bodega / Tours, a cart, wines with bottle and per-litre prices (€15.50 to €79), photographs of vineyard work and black pigs, en/de/es switch. No hours or street address.

sites.name: Château Lafon-Rochet
sites.why: Saint-Estèphe Grand Cru Classé, Bordeaux. Yes/No legal-age gate (No goes to google.com), cookie choice with 'necessary only', headline 'La pépite de Saint-Estèphe' and a Découvrir la propriété button, menu with Visiter le Domaine leading to a contact page, three wines with Découvrir buttons, grape mix stated, address and phone in the footer, Fr/En. No shop, prices or visit hours.

sites.name: Champagne De Lossy
sites.why: Champagne house in Rilly-la-Montagne. Age gate with a year-of-birth field and language choice before 'Enter the site', headline 'Living beautifully since 1862', a three-link menu (legacy, champagne, Buy Now), Buy Now in the header to an external Shopify store, photographs of cellar, vineyard and bottle, sections each ending in Explore, FR/EN. No visits, prices or address.

sites.name: Citadelle Gin
sites.why: French gin distilled at Château de Bonbonnet near Cognac. Oui/Non age question, headline 'Citadelle, le premier gin craft au monde !', three numbered chapters (gin de France, botanicals shown as about 20 icons, a family house open to visitors), five gins listed, Visites in the menu and a visits card, cocktails page, fr/es/en, the French health warning in the footer. No prices on the home page.

sites.name: Sir Chill Gin
sites.why: Belgian gin finished by hand. 'Just a question' overlay asking if the visitor may drink alcohol, headline 'Gin to its perfection', menu Story / Products / Stores / Contact, five product tiles (gin, alcohol free, barrel, tasting box, personalise your gin), 'You can taste Sir Chill here' to a distributor finder, six-language switch. No prices or address.

sites.name: Rutherford Ranch Winery
sites.why: Napa Valley winery on the Silverado Trail. Rotating banners ('Slow down & visit Rutherford', 'Join the family'), a promo strip (15% off, $25 shipping), menu Shop / Visit Us (Reserve Tasting, Torcia Experience, Guided Tour & Tasting) / Wine Club / Events, Make a reservation buttons, wine club with free tastings for four, photographs of guests tasting, goats on the tour and the arched red tasting-room doors. No hours or prices on the home page.

avoid: An age gate whose No button links to nowhere, or that asks for a full birth date digit by digit on every visit.
A 'Visit' menu entry that only leads to an email address, with no formats, prices or dates.
Cellar-door hours and address missing from the home page of an estate that receives visitors.
Image alt text that repeats the page title ('Accueil - ...') on every photograph.
A Buy button that leaves for another store without saying so.
Spelling mistakes in the legal health warning.
Wine pages with a bottle shot and a poetic paragraph but no grape, vintage or price.
